description: The system shall allow delegated users to log in using their email or phone number.
The system must allow entering an email address or a phone number.
The system must send an OTP code to the indicated address or number.
The user must be able to enter the received OTP code.
If the code is correct, the user must log in successfully.
The system must handle authentication errors and incorrect codes.
The system shall display a Home screen with relevant business information for authenticated users.
The Home screen must show several independent informative widgets.
Each widget must load its data autonomously.
The system must show loading and error states when necessary.
The system shall provide intelligent response suggestions for reviews using the Cintia AI agent.
The system must detect if the user has the Cintia functionality activated.
If Cintia is active, the system must show a response suggestion automatically upon opening the response modal.
The system must display the response progressively (typing effect).
The system shall allow users to view images and videos associated with a review.
The system must display images and videos associated with a review under the review text.
Images must be navigable via horizontal scroll.
Clicking an image or video must display it in full screen.
The application must provide an intuitive and coherent interface that allows users to complete main tasks without prior training.
The application must function correctly on Android and iOS devices with different screen sizes and supported OS versions.
System responses must have an acceptable response time, avoiding UI freezes or blocks.
User data must be transmitted and managed securely, ensuring only authorized users can access the information.
The code must be structured following best practices and architecture patterns that facilitate system maintenance and evolution.
